_help: User rules: original sentence in 'text' + structured 'rules'. target: { items: [ids] } | { groups: [names] } | { tags: [...] }. rule types: onFloor, upright, noRotate, noLoadOnTop, maxLoadOnTop {kg}, zone {end: cab|door, withinCm}, loadGroup {n} (1 = loaded first, cab end), exclude, flex, optional (packed after all must-have items, dropped first). 'hard': false makes a zone a preference instead of a must.

constraints.text: Boxes go last: fit the non-box items first, then fill the rest with boxes and bags. Boxes are the first thing we take out if there isn't enough space.
We would lay the bikes on top of the load.
constraints.note: switched off 2026-10-15: bikes and boxes can be packed any way
